claude_proposed_widenings.name: ModifySpeedOperation
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Longstrider's sole combat-relevant mechanic is a numeric speed increase (+10 ft) that persists on the target for the duration. The existing OngoingOperation union (roll_modifier | damage_on_hit) has no variant for this. The v4 atom modify_speed exists in the taxonomy but is unreachable from the surface. A new OngoingOperation variant { kind: 'modify_speed'; deltaFeet: number } would cover Longstrider cleanly and generalise to any spell or feature that buffs or debuffs movement speed (Slow, Haste speed component, Barbarian Fast Movement, etc.).
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The target's Speed increases by 10 feet until the spell ends.
